statement: Between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-04, the Russian Ministry of Defense or the Moscow mayor reports 100 or more Ukrainian UAVs intercepted over Moscow city or Moscow Oblast on a single calendar day.
resolution: True if a Russian MoD or Moscow mayoral statement, carried by Reuters or AP, gives a single-day Moscow-region intercept count of 100 or more for any day 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-04.
failure_condition: No single-day Moscow-region intercept figure of 100 or more is issued by Russian officials for any day in the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-04, the Saudi Ministry of Defense announces the interception or impact of at least one Houthi-claimed drone or missile directed at Riyadh. Reference: Riyadh airport smoke and Houthi claim on 2026-09-19.
resolution: True if Saudi Press Agency publishes a MoD statement on a drone or missile aimed at Riyadh in the window and Reuters or AP carries it.
failure_condition: No Saudi MoD statement on a drone or missile directed at Riyadh appears for the window.

statement: The NYMEX WTI front-month contract settles below 90.00 dollars on at least one trading day between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-16. Reference: 96.08 on the packet date after a 9.21 percent one-day fall.
resolution: True if the CME Group official settlement for front-month WTI is below 90.00 on any trading day 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-16.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement in the window is at or above 90.00.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield (FRED series DGS10) closes at or above 5.25 percent on at least one day between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 5.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if any DGS10 daily value dated 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-30 is 5.25 or higher.
failure_condition: No DGS10 daily value in the window reaches 5.25.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog gains an entry with a date-added value between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-02 for a vulnerability whose product field names an npm package, the npm CLI, or the Node.js runtime.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry with dateAdded in the window and a product or vendor field matching npm or Node.js.
failure_condition: No KEV entry dated in the window names npm, the npm CLI, or Node.js in its product or vendor field.

statement: Between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-05, OpenAI publishes a security advisory, changelog entry, or blog post acknowledging a Codex sandbox escape and stating a fix or mitigation.
resolution: True if a page on an openai.com domain dated in the window references a Codex sandbox escape and a fix, and BleepingComputer or The Hacker News reports the publication.
failure_condition: No OpenAI-published acknowledgment with a stated fix for the Codex sandbox escape appears in the window.

statement: Friedrich Merz ceases to hold the office of German Chancellor, by resignation or a successful Bundestag constructive vote of no confidence, between 2026-09-21 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: True if the Bundestag official record or Bundesregierung site records Merz leaving office in the window and Reuters or DW confirm.
failure_condition: Merz still holds the office of Chancellor on 2026-12-18 with no recorded resignation or lost constructive no-confidence vote in the window.

statement: The sister of Imran Khan arrested on 2026-09-20 is released from custody, by bail or discharge, between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-04.
resolution: True if Dawn and one wire service (Reuters or AP) report her release from custody within the window.

statement: At least one person is formally charged with murder in a New South Wales court in connection with the Blue Mountains stabbing of 2026-09-20, between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-02.
resolution: True if NSW Police or a NSW court listing records a murder charge for the Blue Mountains stabbing within the window, reported by ABC Australia or the Guardian.
failure_condition: No murder charge relating to the Blue Mountains stabbing is laid in the window.

statement: USGS records an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with epicenter within 250 km of the 2026-09-20 M6.4 Kainantu, Papua New Guinea event, between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-04.
resolution: True if the USGS earthquake catalog lists an M6.0 or greater event in the window within 250 km of the us7000tiqc epicenter.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog shows no M6.0 or greater event within 250 km of the reference epicenter in the window.
